Game Overview

In Ascend, the core idea is straightforward: ascend challenges you to bounce ever higher through a celestial journey. Engage in skillful platform hopping, navigating vanish-prone platforms to achieve massive combos. Compete against friends on online leaderboards, refining your strategy to dominate the skies in this addictive, high-flying adventure.
